docRequirement: statusline.md:1017 — "The `subagentStatusLine` setting renders a custom row body for each subagent shown in the agent panel below the prompt", replacing the default `name · description · token count` row. :1028 — the command "runs once per refresh tick and receives all visible subagent rows as a single JSON object on stdin", carrying the base hook input fields, a `columns` field with the usable row width, and a `tasks` array whose entries have `id`, `name`, `type`, `status`, `description`, `label`, `startTime`, `model`, `effort`, `contextWindowSize`, `tokenCount`, `tokenSamples`, `cwd`. :1034 — "Write one JSON line to stdout per row you want to override, in the form {\"id\": \"<task id>\", \"content\": \"<row body>\"}"; content is rendered as-is including ANSI colors and OSC 8 hyperlinks, an omitted `id` keeps the default row, and an empty `content` hides it. :1036 — the same trust and `disableAllHooks` gates as `statusLine` apply, and "Plugins can ship a default `subagentStatusLine` in their settings.json".
current: The identifier does not exist in fork source. `grep -rain subagentStatusLine` over the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/.references and the doc-sweep's own data files) returns nothing; the only `statusLine` spelling anywhere in source is an unrelated markdown-parsing local at packages/shared/src/sessions/storage.ts:901-902. The surface it would customize does exist and is even built from this page's sibling: apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/ChatDisplay.tsx:2323-2339 mounts `AgentPanel` between the message list and the composer citing `sub-agents.md:1023`, and the row body is hard-coded at apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/AgentPanel.tsx:233-260 as icon + `row.agent` (or the `fork` label) + ` · row.task` + `row.status` + two icon buttons. That body is NARROWER than the default the page describes: `toAgentPanelRows` (AgentPanel.tsx:75-86) projects only `agentId`, `agent`, `task`, `status`, `fork`, so the panel shows no token count at all, even though the wire summary carries `inputTokens`/`outputTokens` (packages/core/src/types/pi-harness-runtime.ts:155-156). The second subagent row renderer, `AgentRow` in apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/SubagentCard.tsx:84-126, is the in-transcript progress card, not the panel below the prompt, and is equally unoverridable. There is no settings-key reader: the fork's non-managed settings documents are read in exactly one place, packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-automations.ts:135-149, and only `disableAllHooks` is lifted out of them (parsed at packages/shared/src/automations/hooks-config.ts:111 and stripped from the event map at :106; the user-scope document is `hooks.json` in `CONFIG_DIR`, hooks-config.ts:8 + :52). The only Claude settings-file module, packages/shared/src/agent/claude-settings-store.ts:27-35 and :119, is an additive permissions-rule writer with no other key. The plugin-shipped-default half is dead too: packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 registers `{ externalKind: 'settings', field: 'settings', defaultPath: 'settings.json' }` in `CLAUDE_RETAINED_SURFACE_FIELDS`, and `addClaudeRetainedSurfaceDeferrals` (claude.ts:2278-2317) only `existsSync`-checks the file and pushes `plugin.deferred.claude_settings`; the row carries no `refusal`, so the author diagnostic at :2307-2315 never fires. Data for the documented `tasks` fields mostly exists but is not projected: the persisted child record has `createdAt` (packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/child-session-port.ts:93) and `restrictions.model` / `restrictions.thinkingLevel` (:19, :21) while the summary exposes none of them. No ANSI or OSC 8 renderer exists on the renderer side (no ansi dependency in package.json; the apparent `ansi` grep hits in packages/ui are substrings of "transition").
divergence: The whole mechanism is absent, in four separable pieces. (1) No reader for the `subagentStatusLine` key at any scope — user, project, or managed — so the documented settings object is inert wherever a user writes it. (2) No per-refresh-tick command runner for it and no NDJSON `{"id","content"}` parser, hence no row-override, no hide-on-empty-content, no keep-default-on-omitted-id. (3) The plugin-shipped default is swallowed: a Claude bundle whose `settings.json` declares it is recorded as `plugin.deferred.claude_settings` with no author-facing warning (claude.ts:2275 has no `refusal`) — the same silent-deferral shape as f053, which owns that half. (4) Even with a runner, the row data model cannot fill the documented `tasks` array: `PiHarnessChildSummaryV1` (packages/core/src/types/pi-harness-runtime.ts:141-159) supplies only `id`/`name`/`type`-equivalents (`agentId`, `agent`, `task`), `status` on a different vocabulary (`starting|running|completed|failed|stopped|interrupted` vs the page's task statuses) and raw `inputTokens`/`outputTokens`; `description`, `label`, `startTime`, `model`, `effort`, `contextWindowSize`, `tokenCount`, `tokenSamples` and `cwd` are all missing from the wire shape, though `createdAt`, `restrictions.model` and `restrictions.thinkingLevel` exist on the persisted record one layer down. One further mismatch is a design decision, not a rename: the contract is terminal-shaped — `columns` is a usable row width in characters and `content` is rendered as-is with ANSI and OSC 8 — and the only surface we have for it is an Electron React panel with no ANSI/OSC renderer, while apps/cli renders no subagent rows at all.

change.what: Lift `subagentStatusLine` out of a settings document the same way `disableAllHooks` already is: validate the object (`type: 'command'` + non-empty `command`, optional `padding`, `refreshInterval` with minimum 1) at :111 next to the existing `disableAllHooks` read, return it on `HooksLoadResult`, and add its key to the destructure at :106 so the bare-map form does not read it as a lifecycle event name. Reject a malformed object into `errors` rather than dropping it silently.

Collect the parsed `subagentStatusLine` per document with scope precedence (project over user; managed wins) and expose it on the returned runtime object. Gate it on exactly the switches already resolved here: return none when `options.managedDisableAllHooks === true` (:113) and when `settingsDisableAllHooks` is set (:143/:151), which is the page's `disableAllHooks` gate at :1036.

change.symbol: new module — SubagentStatusLineConfig, buildSubagentStatusLineStdin, parseSubagentStatusLineOutput, runSubagentStatusLine
change.what: New file. `buildSubagentStatusLineStdin` composes the single stdin object: base hook input fields, `columns`, and the `tasks` array. `parseSubagentStatusLineOutput` parses stdout as NDJSON, one `{id, content}` per line, ignoring blank lines and reporting malformed ones as diagnostics; an omitted id means keep the default row, `content: ""` means hide the row. `runSubagentStatusLine` executes once per refresh tick with a timeout and cancels an in-flight run when a newer tick starts (statusline.md:1106). Do NOT invent a process shape: reuse the hooks runner's, which already pipes `JSON.stringify(payload)` on stdin under a clamped timeout and an AbortSignal — packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:79-98 (`PluginHookRunnerRequest.stdin`, `PluginHookRunner`) and :397-420 (`runInvocation`). Only the stdout parser differs from `parseHookOutput` (:241).

Add the optional fields the documented `tasks` entry needs and the persisted record can already supply: `startTime` (from `PiChildSessionRecordV1.createdAt`, child-session-port.ts:93), `model` and `effort` (from `restrictions.model` / `restrictions.thinkingLevel`, :19/:21), `label`, `description`, `cwd`, `tokenCount`, `contextWindowSize`, `tokenSamples`. All optional; the page itself omits `model`/`contextWindowSize` for an unresolved model (:1030) and `effort` when the subagent inherits the session level (:1032). WIRE TYPE — see blastRadius.

Grow the `exact(child, ['agentId', …, 'error'])` allowlist to include every field added above and validate each with the existing helpers (`text`, `integer`, `finite`, `enumValue`). This is not optional bookkeeping: the list is closed, so an enriched snapshot from a newer host is currently rejected wholesale as `pi-harness-runtime-invalid`.

Carry the new fields through the field-by-field snapshot build with the same `boundedRuntimeText` / numeric bounds the neighbouring fields use, reading `createdAt` and `restrictions` off the child record.

change.symbol: AgentPanelRow (:35), toAgentPanelRows (:75), AgentPanelProps (:43), the row body (:233-260)

blastRadius: Crosses a wire boundary AND a persistence boundary — both risk triggers in this repo. The wire shape `PiHarnessChildSummaryV1` is validated with a CLOSED field list (packages/shared/src/protocol/pi-harness-runtime.ts:170 `exact(child, [...])`), produced field-by-field at packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:3174, and consumed by packages/core/src/types/index.ts, AgentPanel.tsx and its test; a host and renderer of different versions must both tolerate the new fields, and the parser fails closed today. The data source is the persisted `PiChildSessionStateV1` / `PiChildSessionRecordV1` (schemaVersion 1) in packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/child-session-port.ts:61-102, written by packages/server-core/src/pi-harness/child-session-service.ts — reading `createdAt`/`restrictions` needs no migration, but any new persisted field would. Snapshot tests that assert the child shape will move: packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.pi-runtime-snapshot.test.ts, SessionManager.agent-view.test.ts, fork-parent-scope.test.ts, protocol/pi-harness-runtime.test.ts. The renderer side touches ChatDisplay.tsx:2328 (the only `AgentPanel` mount), useAgentPanel.ts (6 `AgentPanelRow` callers) and __tests__/AgentPanel.test.tsx. The settings-reader change lands in the one place all non-managed settings documents are read (runtime-automations.ts:135-149), which is also the `disableAllHooks` decision point, so a mistake there silences or un-silences hooks — its suite is packages/shared/src/capabilities/__tests__/runtime-automations.test.ts (the `disableAllHooks` describe at :981). Executing a user-authored command is a new trust surface: it must be gated exactly like hooks (project trust plus both levels of `disableAllHooks`), and the managed level must keep winning. The imported-plugin path is packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 and overlaps f053. Do NOT confuse this with `PluginSettingProjectionRecord` (packages/shared/src/plugins/projection.ts:124) — that is a plugin-declared configurable setting with a `valueType`, a different subsystem from a Claude settings.json key.
userImpact: None observable today. A user who copies a Claude `settings.json` containing `subagentStatusLine` into the fork gets no change and no error: the agent panel below the prompt keeps rendering its built-in `agent · task · status` row (AgentPanel.tsx:233-260), which is itself narrower than Claude's documented default because it shows no token count. A Claude plugin that ships the default installs with a plain success toast and no author diagnostic (claude.ts:2275 has no `refusal`), so the bundle author has no way to learn the key was dropped. What would surface it: any user or plugin author who moves a working Claude subagent status line over and expects the row body to change — they get silence at both ends, which is the actual cost here rather than a broken pixel.
